result.topic_en: Riemann records linear relations between contiguous hypergeometric P-functions, defined by a contour integral, and uses them to develop a quotient of such functions into a continued fraction.
result.transcription:
$P^\alpha$
Relationen zwischen benachbarten Functionen.
$P\left(\begin{smallmatrix}\alpha & \beta & \gamma \\ \alpha' & \beta' & \gamma'\end{smallmatrix}, x\right) = e^{(\alpha'+\gamma)\pi i}\int s^{-\alpha'-\beta-\gamma'}(1-s)^{-\alpha'-\beta'-\gamma}(1-xs)^{-\alpha-\beta'-\gamma}\,ds\, x^{\alpha}(1-x)^{\gamma}$
$P(\alpha'+1)+P(\beta'+1)+P(\gamma'+1)=0$ $P(\alpha'+1)+P(\beta+1)-P(\gamma+1)=0$, $P(\beta'+1)+P(\gamma+1)-P(\alpha+1)=0$ $P(\gamma'+1)+P(\alpha+1)-P(\beta+1)=0$
$(\alpha+\beta'+\gamma')P(\alpha+1)+(\alpha'+\beta+\gamma')P(\beta+1)+(\alpha'+\beta'+\gamma)P(\gamma+1)=0$
$+(\alpha'+\beta+\gamma)P(\alpha'+1)+(\alpha'+\beta'+\gamma)P(\beta'+1)-(\alpha'+\beta+\gamma')P(\gamma'+1)=0$
$(\alpha'+\beta+\gamma)P(\beta+1)+(\alpha'+\beta'+\gamma')P(\gamma'+1)-(\alpha'+\beta'+\gamma)P(\alpha'+1)=0$ $\alpha+\alpha'+\beta+\beta'+\gamma+\gamma'=0$
$(\alpha+\beta+\gamma)P(\gamma+1)+(\alpha'+\beta+\gamma')P(\alpha'+1)-(\alpha+\beta'+\gamma')P(\beta'+1)=0$
Entwicklung in einen Kettenbruch

$P(\alpha'+1)+P(\beta'+1)+P(\gamma'+1)=0$ $P(\alpha+1)+P(\beta+1)-P(\gamma'+1)=0$, $P(\beta+1)+P(\gamma+1)-P(\alpha'+1)=0$ $P(\gamma+1)+P(\alpha+1)-P(\beta'+1)=0$

$(\alpha')-(\beta')+(\gamma)=0$

$P^\alpha=\int_0^1$ $P^{\beta}=\int_0^\infty$ $P^{\gamma}=\int_0^{\frac1x}$ $\frac{\alpha'+\beta'+\gamma'}{\alpha-\alpha'}\frac{P(\alpha'+1)}{P(\beta'+1)}=1+\cfrac{\frac{\alpha+\beta+\gamma'\;\;\alpha+\beta+\gamma}{(\alpha-\alpha')(\alpha-\alpha'+1)}x}{1+\cfrac{\frac{\alpha+\beta+\gamma+1\;\;\alpha+\beta'+\gamma'+1}{(\alpha-\alpha'+1)(\alpha-\alpha'+2)}x}{1+}}$
$P^{\alpha'}=\int_{\frac1x}^\infty$ $P^{\beta'}=\int_0^{\frac1x}$ $P^{\gamma'}=\int_1^\infty$
$(\alpha'+\beta+\gamma)P(\alpha'+1)+(\alpha+\beta+\gamma')P(\alpha+1)+(\alpha-\alpha')P(\beta'+1)=0$

methods.what: Euler-type integral representation of the Riemann P-function
Three-term linear relations between contiguous P-functions with exponents shifted by 1

Different branches as integrals over different paths between singular points
Continued fraction expansion (Gauss-type) for a quotient of contiguous P-functions
